role: Accountable common/coarse elevation foundation beneath independently justified regional visual information; neither analytical policy nor universally best-detail surface.
candidates: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, using explicitly identified public 2021 COG distribution for this bounded test
selectionRationale: One alternative with broad land coverage, identified radar/editing/filling lineage, declared EGM2008 heights, open derivative rights and reproducible access. No extra candidate added solely to enlarge the survey.
decisionCriteriaBeforeNumericalResults: Documented terrain and vertical semantics; unknown height lineage prevents physical reference claims.
Identifiable release, frozen asset hashes, accessible source inputs and reproducible processing.
Global/near-global land support, explicit missing/ocean/polar limitations; a hosting service is not a dataset.
Rights permitting derivative delivery with explicit obligations.
Stable-overlap relationship: spatial residuals and registration consistency, not only lowest RMS.
Coarse-parent generation feasibility and coherent large-scale source support.
Operational source volume and revision burden feasible to plan, without requiring full mirroring now.

comparison.swiss: Area-average official LV95 DTM onto 400x400 diagnostic grid.
comparison.global: Bilinear source sampling/reprojection onto same horizontal grid; shared sampling does not establish identical measurement footprints.
comparison.height: Raw LN02 versus declared EGM2008 first. A separately recorded Swiss-to-EGM2008 diagnostic only if authoritative grids/defined operation are available. AWS never receives an invented height transformation.
comparison.mask: Independent land-cover, glacier inventories and source-support evidence, then slope screening; never use elevation differences to decide primary mask.

primary.landCover: bare/sparse vegetation only; conservative cell exclusion for other classes

comparison.registration: Nuth-Kaab translation signature expressed as robust difference ~ east/north gradient + vertical intercept; slope/aspect bins, independent quadrants and held-out spatial blocks. Diagnostic coefficients only; no product corrected. Fit clipping retained separately from the independent mask.

exclusions: No reconciliation, feathering, source selection, terrain hierarchy, production migration, analytical migration or imagery processing.
